activity.title: Late update but better than never: I graduated as Valedictorian and am headed to Harvard University ! 🥳 I am so beyond grateful and honored to share that I was accepted into all the colleges I applied to, including: Harvard University , Massachusetts Institute of Technology , Stanford University , Princeton University , Yale University (YES Scholar + Likely Letter), Columbia University (Science Research Fellow + Likely Letter), University of Pennsylvania , The Johns Hopkins University (Hodson Scholar). Attending admit weekends and hearing the stories of so many students from across the country was one of the most humbling and inspiring experiences of this process. As I head to Harvard, I plan to concentrate in chemistry and continue to explore science and research on a pre-med track. The list of people I would like to thank is endless, and I wouldn’t be able to tag them all in a simple post. To everyone who has believed in me and supported me on this journey, both through the lows and the highs, I am endlessly grateful. Roll Crimson! #Harvard #Harvard2030 ...more ...more
